_why: Product cards for the Shopee affiliate funnel. Each card is a general buying-guidance video bedded on an AERIS song; it points at the per-surface affiliate link (s.shopee.co.th, Sub_id = surface) so a sale is attributed to the app it came from. The links are NOT stored here — make_affiliate_short.py resolves them per surface via monetize.link(). Each card carries a `hookline`: the first-3-seconds scroll-stopper, distinct from `title` (the topic). Shorts are decided in the first 3 seconds, so the opening line is the benefit or the question, not the topic name.
_rules: No first-hand claim: we have not tested these products, so the card gives buying guidance, not a review.
No over-claim (รวย/กำไร/100%/ดีที่สุด) — make_affiliate_short.py refuses a card that carries one.
Every caption carries the affiliate disclosure line (COMPLIANCE.md).
Target category matches the minted links: Bluetooth headphones / listening gear (หูฟังบลูทูธ).

Packaging is search-first. A 2026-11-09 Google Suggest pull showed `ของน่าซื้อ` is a souvenir/gift term (ของน่าซื้อญี่ปุ่น/เกาหลี/ดองกิ), NOT a headphone-buying term, so tagging the funnel with it reached nobody who was shopping. Each card now carries a `search` field: the real Thai query it answers (หูฟังบลูทูธ ยี่ห้อไหนดี, หูฟัง ตัดเสียงรบกวน ยี่ห้อไหนดี, หูฟัง ราคาไม่เกิน 500, หู ฟัง ใส่ นอน ไม่ เจ็บ). The title and tags are built from that query, because on a zero-follower channel search is the only free discovery path.
